title: The Stolen Street
intro_text: The twilight city has gone dark. Fragmented blocks litter the alleyways. Take up the Pixel Glove to clear a path.

levels.name: The Blocked Alley
levels.hint: A heavy fragment obstructs the passage. Siphon it into your glove, then proceed to the exit.

levels.name: The Side Pocket
levels.hint: Two fragments block your way, but your glove holds only one. Siphon the first and drop it in the side pocket to reach the second.

levels.name: Turnabout
levels.hint: Choose where to set down your stolen fragment carefully. Placing a block turns it back into a solid obstacle.

levels.name: Squeeze Point
levels.hint: A narrow alley forces you to maneuver. Relocate the fragment into a holding niche to squeeze forward.

levels.name: The Double Gate
levels.hint: Two massive blockades seal the exit avenue. Stash each obstacle into its designated alcove to clear the avenue.
